The dendritic recordings (Layer M1, M5, M10) all peak at roughly the same time (~0.11 s), whereas the cell‑body recording peaks noticeably later (~0.19 s), a difference marked as significant (***). Thus the cell body has the distinct peak time.

[ANSWER]D[/ANSWER]
